request_curl: curl --location 'https://api.scaninfoga.com/api/v1/mobile/mobile-to-lpg-details' --header 'Content-Type: application/json' --header 'api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' --data '{ "mobile_number": "884985xxxx", "purpose": "verification", "consent": "I confirm that I have obtained user consent to access and process data for verification and compliance purposes." }'

title: Mobile To Advance Profile

title: Account Penny Drop
description: Verify a bank account in real time by sending a ₹1 penny drop transfer and returning the beneficiary name, bank and branch details, and transaction status.
